name: unit_commander_claims
title: Evidence links from commander tenures to claims (data/unit_commander_claims.csv)
description: Hand-maintained. One row per (tenure, claim) link. A command-change claim can assert a start or end; a location claim that simply names the officer is observed_during. Parallel to data/command_relation_claims.csv.

fields.name: claim_id
fields.description: The claim that names this person in this role, or that dates a vacancy ending the tenure.

fields.name: role
fields.description: What the claim says about the tenure (vocabulary commander_claim_role).

fields.name: stated_note
fields.description: The qualifier or clause this claim contributes (killed 6 June, acting, from noon on 21 August).
